mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REVIEW_REPORT ( REPORT_NO, MEMBER_NO, REVIEW_TYPE, CONTENT_REVIEW_NO, PRODUCT_REVIEW_NO, REASON, DETAIL, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_REVIEW_REPORT_NO.NEXTVAL, #{memberNo}, #{reviewType}, #{contentReviewNo, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{productReviewNo, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{reason}, #{detail}, 'WAITING', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT PRODUCT_REVIEW_NO FROM REVIEW_REPORT WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND REVIEW_TYPE = 'PRODUCT'
